newsitem.title: UK: European cotton buyers driven off by U.S. influenc.
newsitem.headline: European cotton buyers driven off by U.S. influenc.

text.p: A recovery in New York cotton futures sent asking prices in the European cash markets significantly higher and drove mill buyers away from the negotiating table, industry sources reported on Thursday.
U.S. styles recovered Wednesday's fall in prices and dragged values for similar types with them, they said.

Further strengthening in the U.S. dollar ensured that the upward trend spread to the rest of the market. There were few confirmed trades reported and only routine price-testing confined to the most popular Central Asian and African origins. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
